segments.he: חֲדָא וְעוֹד קָאָמַר, חֲדָא — דְּבָעֵינַן לְמִיעְבַּד הֶכֵּירָא בְּחָדָשׁ וְיָשָׁן, וְעוֹד — מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא יוֹם טוֹב, וְאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְעַשֵּׂר בְּיוֹם טוֹב מִשּׁוּם סְקַרְתָּא.
segments.en: The Gemara answers: The mishna «states one» reason «and» adds «another. One» reason is «that we require a distinction between the new» animals «and the old» animals. «And another» reason is «because it is» the «festival» of Rosh HaShana «and one cannot tithe on a Festival, due to the sakreta,» a lead-based red paint for marking every tenth animal, as explained on 58b. It is prohibited to apply paint on a Festival.

moves.summary: two reasons: new/old distinction and no painting on a Festival

edges.about: the mishna gives one reason and adds another
the mishna's Festival reason is a second reason beside new/old; tithing needs red paint, forbidden on a Festival

positions.claim: one cannot tithe on a Festival because marking with sakreta is forbidden
